label: 3 John 1:1
text: The elder unto the wellbeloved Gaius, whom he loveth in the truth.

label: 3 John 1:2
text: Beloved, he wisheth above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth.

label: 3 John 1:3
text: For he rejoiced greatly, when the brethren came and testified of the truth that is in thee, even as thou walkest in the truth.

label: 3 John 1:4
text: He hath no greater joy than to hear that his children walk in truth.

label: 3 John 1:5
text: Beloved, thou doest faithfully whatsoever thou doest to the brethren, and to strangers;

label: 3 John 1:6
text: Which have borne witness of thy charity before the church: whom if thou bring forward on their journey after a godly sort, thou shalt do well:

label: 3 John 1:7
text: Because that for my name's sake they went forth, taking nothing of the Gentiles.

label: 3 John 1:8
text: Ye therefore ought to receive such, that ye might be fellowhelpers to the truth.

label: 3 John 1:9
text: The elder wrote unto the church: but Diotrephes, who loveth to have the preeminence among them, receiveth him not.

label: 3 John 1:10
text: Wherefore, if he come, he will remember his deeds which he doeth, prating against him with malicious words: and not content therewith, neither doth he himself receive the brethren, and forbiddeth them that would, and casteth them out of the church.

label: 3 John 1:11
text: Beloved, follow not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that doeth good is of my Father: but he that doeth evil hath not seen my Father.

label: 3 John 1:12
text: Demetrius hath good report of all men, and of the truth itself: yea, and he also beareth record; and ye know that his record is true.

label: 3 John 1:13
text: He had many things to write, but he will not with ink and pen write unto thee:

label: 3 John 1:14
text: But he trusteth he shall shortly see thee, and they shall speak face to face. Peace be to thee. His friends salute thee. Greet the friends by name.
